painting.title: The Virgin Mary as Mother of Sorrows (Maria als Schmerzensmutter)
painting.identityEvidence: Official collection record identifies artist, title, date, medium, dimensions, inventory 709, holding collection, and explains that this panel fragment belonged with seven scenes of the Sorrows of the Virgin now in Dresden; the original polyptych was sawn apart in the 16th century.

subjectRelation.assessment: Exact devotional subject: Mary as Mater Dolorosa, identified by the museum as the central panel of the Seven Sorrows polyptych.
subjectRelation.qualification: This physical object is the central Mother of Sorrows panel, not the complete seven-scene Dresden group. It is strongly relevant to the devotion but should not be described as a complete seven-sorrows narrative. The associated seven scenes are separate physical works in Dresden.
